guide.title: How credentials work
guide.step1: Issue a certificate here. The private key is shown exactly once and the platform never stores it.
guide.step2: Download the bundle and store all three files on the device; the key never leaves it.
guide.step3: Rotate to hand the device a fresh certificate, or when it changes hands. Revoke to cut access immediately.
guide.step4: A revoked device cannot reconnect until a new certificate is issued.

guide.title: How updates reach this device
guide.intro: JII starts rollouts from a reviewed workflow; devices are never updated from this page.
guide.step1: A release is published in the firmware repository.
guide.step2: An operator starts a rollout, which stages it across devices and stops automatically if too many fail.
guide.step3: The device receives an update job, downloads the image over a short-lived link, and verifies its checksum.
guide.step4: The device applies the update, reboots, and reports the outcome; a failed update rolls back.
